headline: HuyenBao v12.0 — UID system + popup overlap ROOT CAUSE fix + admin create-item bug fix + tips card
summary: MAJOR VERSION. (1) UID generation — every player gets a unique ID on new life; old saves backfilled on migrate; shown in PinZone + admin dashboard; duplicate names on social/leaderboard auto-suffixed with -last5UID. (2) Popup overlap ROOT CAUSE found + fixed — the toast at top-right was sitting EXACTLY over the modal ✕ close button, blocking dismissal. Now: MutationObserver detects open modals → shifts toast to bottom-right while modal is open → ✕ is fully clickable. Also fixed admin .adm-flash pushing forms down (now floating bottom-center) + .adm-btn:disabled opacity 0.4→0.55 (was invisible on dark bg). (3) Admin create-item-from-URL was BROKEN — the createItem API branch was after the uid guard, so every call returned 400. Fixed: moved above the guard. The ➕ Tạo button now actually works. (4) Tips card on HomeTab — 6 curated tips rotating every 30s, clickable → relevant tab. (5) GYM_CD raised to 30 days (1 month) per user request. 4 new tests (201→205).
features: NEW: UID system — genUid() helper, GameState.uid field, begin() assigns on new life, migrate() backfills old saves
NEW: UID shown in PinZone as small monospace chip (last 6 chars) next to player name
NEW: UID column in admin dashboard player table (full id in tooltip, truncated head…tail display)
NEW: dedupeNames() helper — duplicate names on social/leaderboard get -last5UID suffix automatically
NEW: useDedupe() hook wired into ChatView, FriendsView, BoardView for name disambiguation
FIX: popup overlap ROOT CAUSE — toast at top-right was blocking modal ✕ close button. MutationObserver shifts toast to bottom-right while modal is open
FIX: admin .adm-flash was pushing forms down (inline element) → now position:fixed bottom-center floating toast
FIX: admin .adm-btn:disabled opacity 0.4→0.55 so the ➕ Tạo button is visible even when disabled on dark background
FIX: admin create-item-from-URL API was BROKEN — createItem branch was after uid guard → 400 error. Moved above guard → works now
FIX: .modal-x close button hit target enlarged (min-width:36px, min-height:32px) for easier mobile tapping
NEW: Tips card on HomeTab — 6 curated tips rotating every 30s, clickable → relevant tab (assets/home/bank/biz/edu/finance-overview)
NEW: tip.title + tip.1-6 i18n keys (EN/VI/中文)
CHANGE: GYM_CD raised to 30 days (1 month) — was 3 days in v11.57, user requested 1 month
NEW: 4 new tests (201→205): GYM_CD regression, UID lifecycle, migrate backfill, genUid uniqueness (1000-call collision check)
